event.text: Point and Vector in Python semio are Pydantic/SModel - they have .x, .y, .z. So we're good. Now the test: we need to serialize GeometricInsights to JSON that matches the canonical. The canonical currently has bounding_box_min as [x,y,z] and centroid as [x,y,z]. So we have two options: (1) change canonical to use {x,y,z} objects, (2) keep canonical as arrays. User said "use semio data types: points, plane, vector" - so the API uses Point/Vector. For the report JSON we can serialize Point as {"x":..., "y":..., "z":...} and Vector same. So the canonical asset should use that format. Then in the test we build `data` from insights: for Point we do {"x": p.x, "y": p.y, "z": p.z}, for Vector same, for list of Vector we do list of such objects. So we need a small helper to convert insights to a JSON-serializable dict that uses explicit semio shape. Then we regenerate the canonical asset by running the Python code and saving that output (with rounded numbers) to model-kpi-nakagin.json. Let me add a helper in the test or in semio.py to export GeometricInsights to a dict suitable for JSON, then use that in the test and to generate the canonical file.
